about_the_game:
Welcome to "Strange day"

On a strange day when no one is around, Nick heads to 4th Street. There, he becomes entangled in a mysterious incident and is transported back to the past of a murder scene that occurred days ago. Nick must solve the puzzles left behind by the perpetrator to unravel the case. Will Nick be able to solve this mystery?

This game includes elements of math and puzzles. You need to solve this problems and mistery!

Game Features:

 Exploration and Narrative Elements: Players will explore various city regions, uncover   hidden clues, and solve puzzles to progress through the story.

Psychological Tension: The unique in-game environment, shifting between reality and hallucinations, creates a sense of suspense and tension for the player.

Immersive Graphics and Audio: The dark, surreal city environment combines with distinctive visual elements, offering a unique experience. Additionally, the audio design enhances the game's atmosphere, further immersing players in the world.
